name: glass-chrome
description: Liquid Glass on the controls only: a glass sidebar with glass cards and group headers, a glass tab strip and address bar over Monet, and solid panes for everything you read.

files.themes/glass-chrome.json:
// Glass: chrome. Liquid Glass where the controls are (the sidebar, its cards and group headers, the
// tab strip and the address bar) and solid panes for everything you read: the platform's rule that
// glass is the layer floating over content, never the content.
// Monet's water lilies sit behind it, so the glass has color to bend.
{
  "name": "Glass: chrome",
  "description": "Liquid Glass sidebar, tab strip and address bar over Monet; solid terminal, chat and pages.",

  "appearance.theme": "Apple System Colors",
  "colors": { "background": "#121417", "foreground": "#e8ecef", "selection": "#2a3b33", "accent": "#8fd6a8" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The window: regular Liquid Glass over the painting, a little of it showing through the chrome.
  "appearance.background": "monet-water-lilies",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.7,
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.35,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,

  // The chrome: glass. A separate sidebar at 40%, the tab strip at 45%, sections and group headers
  // as glass cards, a hairline edge.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#101214",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.4,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#101214",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 0.45,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#101214",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 0.45,
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 0.5,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "card",
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "regular",
  "browser.omnibar.glassTint": "accent",
  "browser.omnibar.glassTintStrength": 0.25,

  // The content: solid, so text never sits on glass.
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#121417",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#121417",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#121417",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#121417",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,

  // Panes as cards floating on the glass, rounded like the glass around them.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "card",

  // Shape, not only color (Leo: "customizing the tabs/sidebars a lot deeper"): glass chrome: 10 pt tabs and rows on a 270 pt sidebar.
  "density": { "basedOn": "cozy", "tokens": {"tabCornerRadius": 10, "verticalTabCornerRadius": 10, "sidebarCornerRadius": 10, "itemCornerRadius": 8, "sidebarWidth": 270, "sidebarRowGap": 2, "tabGap": 4 } },
  "window.titlebarButtons": "always",
  "tabs.plusButton": "always",
  "agentPane.display.sessionInfo.placement": "overlay"
}
